title: Taurus wants the same date. Forever.
caption: A surprise firework on a random Tuesday is fun for about four seconds. What Taurus really needs is someone who shows up the same way, every Friday, week after week. Steady is a beautiful kind of romance. Send this to the Taurus with a standing date.
